**About 2.33 billion tokens on yyot, with an estimated API-equivalent cost of roughly $1,750**, through **October 11, 2026**.

| Records | Tokens | Estimated cost |
|---|---:|---:|
| Available logs, calculated by ccusage | 2.194 billion | $1,643.25 |
| 54 older chats with missing logs | 138 million | ~$103 extrapolated |
| **Combined estimate** | **2.332 billion** | **~$1,747** |

Used **ccusage 20.0.29**, including yyot’s worktrees and subagents. About **97%** of the available-log tokens were cached input.

The missing-log cost assumes the same average rate. These are approximate API equivalents, not actual subscription charges. [ccusage methodology](https://ccusage.com/guide/codex/)

content.text:
**Exact model-generation TPS is unavailable from retained logs.** A clearly labeled **effective output tokens/sec** is calculable.

Verified:

- `token_usage_record.usage` has token counts, no inference timing.
- `task_complete` has `duration_ms`, `time_to_first_token_ms`, `started_at`, and `completed_at`.
- `item_completed` has item start/end timestamps, but no corresponding item token counts or complete response timing.
- Scoped `logs_2.sqlite` contained ~9,199 yyot log rows. Found tool-duration fields, but no model-response duration or first/last-token timing.
- Alternate `.codex/sqlite/logs_2.sqlite` had no matching yyot rows.

Defensible calculation per model:

`effective output tokens/sec = Σ final turn output_tokens ÷ Σ completed-turn duration seconds`

This includes tools, waits, prompt processing, and reasoning. It is **not decoding speed**. Output token counts already include reasoning; do not add reasoning tokens again.

Exclude inherited fork-history completions: require matching owned `thread_id` usage records, then deduplicate `(thread_id, turn_id)`. Also isolate or flag turns whose model changed.

Sample sanitized metadata from an archived yyot session:

| Completed turn | Duration | Time to first token |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | 71.763 sec | 17.846 sec |
| 2 | 345.395 sec | 9.290 sec |

Audit was read-only; no changes made.
